name: Planning commands
description: Slash commands for thinking things through: plans, pros and cons, decisions, checklists and meeting notes.

commands.name: plan
commands.prompt:
Turn the goal below into a short plan: numbered steps, each one something I can do in a sitting, with what has to happen first marked clearly.

Goal:

commands.name: pros-cons
commands.prompt:
Lay out the pros and cons of each option below in a table, then say which you'd pick and the one thing that would change your mind.

Options:

commands.name: decide
commands.prompt:
Help me make this decision. Ask me up to three questions first, one at a time, then recommend an option and say why.

The decision:

commands.name: checklist
commands.prompt:
Write a checklist for the task below: the steps in order, what to have ready before starting, and the easy-to-forget parts at the end.

Task:

commands.name: meeting-notes
commands.prompt:
Turn the notes below into: decisions made, action items (who, what, by when), and open questions. Leave out small talk.

Notes:
